title: Platform health
description: Phase 1 smoke dashboard: proves Grafana reads PostgreSQL, and shows the catalog every other dashboard is built from.

panels.title: Stored records
panels.description: Zero everywhere until the phase 2 generator runs. A flat panel with rows present is a dashboard bug; zero rows is expected here.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 'mission' AS table_name, count(*) AS row_count FROM mission
UNION ALL SELECT 'position', count(*) FROM position
UNION ALL SELECT 'observation', count(*) FROM observation
UNION ALL SELECT 'waveform_block', count(*) FROM waveform_block
UNION ALL SELECT 'event', count(*) FROM event
UNION ALL SELECT 'ingest_batch', count(*) FROM ingest_batch
ORDER BY 1;

panels.title: Metric catalog
panels.description: Source of truth for dashboard variables. Adding a row here must be enough to get a new panel (requirement 7).

panels.title: Recent ingest batches
panels.description: Pipeline health: batch_time is when the platform measured, received_at is when the row landed (DEC-01). The gap is end-to-end lag.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT received_at, batch_time,
       round(extract(epoch FROM received_at - batch_time)::numeric, 3) AS lag_s,
       mission_id, device_id, source, seq, record_count, status
FROM ingest_batch
WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at)
ORDER BY received_at DESC
LIMIT 50;
